summary.headline: Judgment Concerning Substance
summary.text: Chapter VI explains horary judgment concerning borrowed or requested substance: the ascendant lord and Moon signify the seeker, while the seventh and eighth houses signify the debtor and his substance, with conjunction and reception determining recovery. The preceding passage contrasts the effects of evil planets and fortunes on outcomes.
